description: Fix the CloudFront redirect edge so every redirect resolves (302 not 404) and country/city geo headers reach the origin. Two coupled changes in infra/lib/snapurl-stack.ts's RedirectCdn Distribution (currently around lines 278-296): (1) add a viewer-request cloudfront.Function that copies the viewer Host into x-forwarded-host, and (2) replace OriginRequestPolicy.ALL_VIEWER_EXCEPT_HOST_HEADER with a custom OriginRequestPolicy that allow-lists exactly the request headers apps/redirect/src/main.ts consumes plus CloudFront-Viewer-Country and CloudFront-Viewer-City, forwards all query strings, and forwards no cookies. Host stays excluded so CloudFront keeps sending the Lambda Function URL's own host (a Function URL origin rejects a mismatched Host). This is infra-only; no app code changes and no DB migration.
steps: Read infra/lib/snapurl-stack.ts (esp. the RedirectCdn Distribution block ~lines 278-296) and apps/redirect/src/main.ts (to confirm the consumed headers) before editing.

Before `const distribution = new cloudfront.Distribution(this, "RedirectCdn", {...})`, create a viewer-request CloudFront Function. Use `new cloudfront.Function(this, "RedirectViewerRequest", { runtime: cloudfront.FunctionRuntime.JS_2_0, comment: "...", code: cloudfront.FunctionCode.fromInline(...) })`. The inline JS (CloudFront Functions restricted runtime) must copy the viewer Host into x-forwarded-host and return the request, e.g.: `function handler(event) { var r = event.request; r.headers['x-forwarded-host'] = { value: r.headers.host.value }; return r; }`. Add a comment noting Phase 7 (#289) will extend this same function for the KeyValueStore edge fast path, so it is intentionally a named, standalone function.

Create a custom origin request policy before the Distribution: `const redirectOriginRequestPolicy = new cloudfront.OriginRequestPolicy(this, "RedirectOrigReqPolicy", { comment: "...", headerBehavior: cloudfront.OriginRequestHeaderBehavior.allowList("user-agent", "referer", "accept-language", "x-forwarded-host", "CloudFront-Viewer-Country", "CloudFront-Viewer-City"), cookieBehavior: cloudfront.OriginRequestCookieBehavior.none(), queryStringBehavior: cloudfront.OriginRequestQueryStringBehavior.all() });`. Do NOT include Host in the allowList. Add a comment explaining WHY Host is excluded (Function URL origin requires Host = origin host; the app now reads the real host from x-forwarded-host that the viewer-request function set) and WHY queryString.all() is required (unlock token `k` and UTM/forwardQuery overrides ride the query string).

In the defaultBehavior of the RedirectCdn Distribution, replace `originRequestPolicy: cloudfront.OriginRequestPolicy.ALL_VIEWER_EXCEPT_HOST_HEADER,` with `originRequestPolicy: redirectOriginRequestPolicy,` and add `functionAssociations: [{ function: <the function var>, eventType: cloudfront.FunctionEventType.VIEWER_REQUEST }],` to the same defaultBehavior. Keep cachePolicy CACHING_DISABLED, viewerProtocolPolicy REDIRECT_TO_HTTPS, allowedMethods ALLOW_GET_HEAD_OPTIONS unchanged.

Update the existing comment near the Distribution (the one mentioning CloudFront-Viewer-Country) so it accurately describes that the custom policy forwards the geo headers and the function supplies x-forwarded-host. Keep it a brief in-file comment; do NOT edit docs/DECISIONS.md (that is issue #290's job).
Verify with type-check and attempt cdk synth (see verification).
acceptance_criteria: A named cloudfront.Function (viewer-request) is created and associated on the RedirectCdn defaultBehavior via functionAssociations with eventType FunctionEventType.VIEWER_REQUEST; its inline code sets x-forwarded-host from the viewer host.

A custom cloudfront.OriginRequestPolicy is created and used on the defaultBehavior with: headerBehavior.allowList containing user-agent, referer, accept-language, x-forwarded-host, CloudFront-Viewer-Country, CloudFront-Viewer-City (and NOT Host); cookieBehavior.none(); queryStringBehavior.all().

The allowList covers every request header apps/redirect/src/main.ts consumes (x-forwarded-host, user-agent, cloudfront-viewer-country, cloudfront-viewer-city, accept-language, referer); the query string is forwarded so `k` and UTM overrides survive.
No changes to apps/, packages/, or web/; no DB migration; docs/DECISIONS.md unchanged.
verification: corepack pnpm type-check  (repo-wide, confirm nothing else broke)

Attempt: cd infra && CDK_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT=000000000000 CDK_DEFAULT_REGION=ap-south-1 corepack pnpm exec cdk synth --context configPrefix=/snapurl/prod 2>&1 | tail -40  -- report outcome; if it fails due to Docker asset staging or missing AWS context, capture the exact error and note synth is not runnable in-sandbox (type-check is authoritative).
git diff --stat to confirm only infra/lib/snapurl-stack.ts changed.
findings: Implemented in infra/lib/snapurl-stack.ts (only file changed). (1) Added a named viewer-request CloudFront Function `RedirectViewerRequest` (FunctionRuntime.JS_2_0) whose inline handler copies request.headers.host.value into request.headers['x-forwarded-host'] and returns the request; commented that Phase 7 (#289) will extend it for the KeyValueStore edge fast path. (2) Added a custom `RedirectOrigReqPolicy` OriginRequestPolicy with headerBehavior.allowList('user-agent','referer','accept-language','x-forwarded-host','CloudFront-Viewer-Country','CloudFront-Viewer-City'), cookieBehavior.none(), queryStringBehavior.all(); Host is intentionally excluded. (3) In RedirectCdn defaultBehavior, replaced originRequestPolicy ALL_VIEWER_EXCEPT_HOST_HEADER with redirectOriginRequestPolicy and added functionAssociations [{ function: redirectViewerRequest, eventType: FunctionEventType.VIEWER_REQUEST }]; cachePolicy CACHING_DISABLED, viewerProtocolPolicy REDIRECT_TO_HTTPS, allowedMethods ALLOW_GET_HEAD_OPTIONS unchanged. (4) Updated the in-file comment near the Distribution to describe the geo-header forwarding and x-forwarded-host; docs/DECISIONS.md left untouched (#290 owns it). VERIFICATION: `corepack pnpm --filter @snapurl/infra type-check` -> exit 0 (pass). `corepack pnpm type-check` (repo-wide) -> exit 0, no regressions. `cdk synth` attempted (CDK_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT=000000000000 CDK_DEFAULT_REGION=ap-south-1, --context configPrefix=/snapurl/prod) -> failed with 'Need to perform AWS calls for account 000000000000, but no credentials have been configured'; this is an environment limitation (no AWS creds/context in sandbox), not a code fault, so synth is not runnable in-sandbox and type-check is the authoritative gate. Removed the empty infra/cdk.context.json and infra/cdk.out artifacts created by the synth attempt. `git diff --stat` confirms only infra/lib/snapurl-stack.ts changed. END-TO-END verification (curl 302 not 404, country rule match, click_events.country populated via scripts/smoke-redirect.sh deployed mode) is DEFERRED to Phase 7 (#289) and NOT claimed here.
